verdict.rationale: Jan runs local models on-device with local data/privacy framing ('full control and privacy', 'Personal Intelligence that answers only to you'), which inherently keeps local usage data out of any training pipeline. However, there's no explicit privacy policy or documented statement about data-training practices for cloud-connected models (OpenAI, Claude, etc.) that users can also plug into, so the story is only partially addressed. Missing for 10: explicit opt-out/data-training policy statement, documentation covering cloud-provider data usage, independent verification of no telemetry/training use.
